description: This file defines routing configurations for a PHP web application, specifically for widget-related routes within the Goteo project. It creates route collection objects, adds routes for project and wof widgets, and specifies controllers and URL patterns.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A class representing a route definition, including URL pattern, defaults, and options.

classes.name: RouteCollection
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of routes, allowing routes to be added and retrieved.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new route to the route collection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Route, initializes a new route with URL pattern and options.
